package.name: awm_geometry
package.description: APLSMN601 OCCT B-Rep helper (ADR-02): STEP import / heal / tessellation, edge catalogue, seam sampling. Pure Python, no rclpy. Runs ONLY in the conda env awm_occ (pythonocc-core 8.0.1, not a rosdep key); called from ROS packages through awm_core.occ_bridge. colcon installs it only so the ROS side can locate it.
